name: leadsmaps
description: Find and score local businesses that need what you sell, check their websites, and get verified business emails for the ones you pick.

interface.longDescription:
Find local businesses that need what you sell, and get verified business emails for the ones you pick.

Describe your ideal customer in a sentence: a type of business, a city, postal code or radius, and the gap you fix — no website, a low rating, few reviews, an unclaimed profile. LeadsMaps searches licensed business listings across 244 countries and returns a scored list, each business with the reasons it is worth contacting.

Check any business's website (HTTPS, mobile, speed, site builder) and size a local market before you commit to it. When you pick businesses, LeadsMaps looks for business emails published on each company's own website and verifies every mailbox, so you get addresses that work instead of guesses. Nothing is unlocked until you confirm.

Ask for a first message and it is drafted from the facts found for that business. LeadsMaps finds and verifies contacts; it never sends messages for you.

Covers 244 countries. Requires a LeadsMaps account. Not affiliated with Google.
defaultPrompt: Find dentists in Austin, TX without a website and tell me why each is worth contacting.
Which roofers in Phoenix, AZ have fewer than 20 reviews? Get verified emails for the top 5.
How many hair salons are there in Miami, FL, and how many are rated under 4.0?

positive.description: Find and score local businesses that match what the user sells.
positive.prompt: Find dentists within 10 km of downtown Austin, TX that have no website.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns dental businesses near downtown Austin without a website, each with a 0–100 score and the reasons it is worth contacting. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Size a local market and the share of businesses with a gap.
positive.prompt: How many hair salons are there in Miami, FL, and how many of them have a rating under 4.0?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the number of hair salons in the Miami area and how many are rated below 4.0. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Check one business and its website.
positive.prompt: Check the first roofing contractor you can find in Phoenix, AZ and summarize the gaps in its online presence.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns that business's listing facts and a check of its website (HTTPS, mobile, speed, site builder), and summarizes the gaps. No credits are spent.

positive.description: Quote the cost of unlocking contacts before anything is charged.
positive.prompt: Find 10 plumbers in Denver, CO and tell me what it would cost to get their contacts.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the most the unlock could cost in credits and the credits remaining. Nothing is charged.

positive.description: Unlock verified business emails after agreeing to the cost.
positive.prompt: Find 5 dentists in Austin, TX that have a website but fewer than 50 reviews, and get verified emails for them. Go ahead with the cost.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the most it can cost, then returns the businesses with a verified email found on their own website. One credit is charged per business with a verified email; the rest are free.

negative.description: App should not be used to send bulk or automated email.
negative.prompt: Email all 500 of these businesses my offer every day until they reply.

negative.description: App should not be used to find personal data about individuals.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and personal cell phone of the owner of Joe's Pizza in Austin.

negative.description: App should not be used for countries not covered by the data provider.
negative.prompt: Find restaurants in Moscow without a website and get me their emails.

publication.release_notes: First release: find and score local businesses worldwide, check websites, size local markets, get verified business emails, export to CSV.
